Id.description: Opaque resource identifier. Do not parse business meaning or assume source database PK type.

RowVersion.description: Optimistic version from the last read of the mutated resource; stale write returns 409.

title.description: Read-only canonical project display name; edit through update_project

row_version.description: Current Spec.row_version, not the workspace version. Omission is accepted only for a locked pristine initial Spec; other source submissions require its current version.

SpecSubmit.description: Exactly one of source_asset_id or source_text is required. Existing initial record may be corrected, not versioned as a specs revision product.

presentation_note.description: Highlighted note printed on this role's last template 1.4.0 page.
Template 1.4.0 role note (1-500 characters), or null to clear it.
Highlighted note printed on the page with this slot's last person (template 1.4.0).

SlotPatch.description: A label change, a template 1.4.0 presentation note change, or both.

casting_id.description: Create/extract null allocates generated casting ID; update null preserves current ID. Non-null changes must be unique. Candidate UUID remains identity.

upload_url.description: A scoped transfer URL for an open session. Closed sessions return null and empty upload_headers.

upload_metadata.description: Exact server-reserved TUS metadata. Never accept a caller-selected destination.

original_transcript.description: Retained original-language provenance; use english_transcript for English display.

processing_issues.description: Safe persisted technical outcomes; originals and useful material remain available. Raw provider errors stay private.

english_transcript.description: English display transcript. Absence is explicit; never substitute original-language text.

portrait_asset_id.description: Project presentation picture: a ready extracted frame or archive photo asset of this person. Library edits never change it.

media_selection_state.description: unset = legacy row, nothing chosen; pinned = chosen (by a person or the add default); intentionally_empty = deliberately no picture.

AssignmentPatch.description: Manual assignment edits remain independent. Explicit AI proposal apply supplies all three review guards and exactly one nonempty slide-wording field; the canonical transaction verifies current proposal/source/series context before writing.

audience_preset_id.description: Explicit review context. Omit it for an ordinary series, which uses the configured default review audience (AUDIENCE_DEFAULT_REQUIRED when none is configured).

cover_note.description: Template 1.4.0 cover note (1-500 characters), or null to clear it.

PresentationVersion.description: Internal fixed-version projection. All content and render_context derive from its immutable snapshot; no private storage destinations or live library values are returned. Ready requires both manifest and PDF assets.

ExternalPresentationVersion.description: Closed external projection from the exact immutable external-audience version. Frozen branding is included; private render destinations, internal notes and review diagnostics are excluded.

grant_token.description: Secret issued to active renderer only; store only verifier server-side and embed in private PDF. Never place raw token in jobs, outbox, manifest, logs or callback.

token.description: Returned once. Treat as a bearer secret; never log it.

access_token.description: Scoped ephemeral review access; no internal/library permissions.

can_retry.description: Current server-derived action for presentation_render, independent of the lifetime attempt count.

can_cancel.description: Current server-derived cancellation action for presentation_render.

candidate_result.description: Present on a succeeded candidate_scan: the person and the project row the upload produced (workspace_candidate_id is null for a re-scan).

status.description: Recorded durable job status for this acknowledgement. Reusing an existing job reports its current status; an idempotent replay may retain its original acknowledgement. Read poll_url for current status.

output_key.description: Stable logical output name within this job attempt. Retries with the same key and metadata reuse the same immutable reservation; conflicting metadata is rejected.

access.description: Lease-scoped exact-object access. Write is only a newly reserved immutable output, never an original.

ServiceAssetAccess.description: Private service-only transfer capability. Headers are credentials and must not enter URLs, ordinary job metadata, logs or n8n envelopes. Exact object, method and lifetime are lease-bound; no arbitrary destination/signing interface exists.

JobOutputReservationResult.description: Actual immutable derivative reservation plus a lease-bound transfer capability. This is a direct new-object POST, not a signed-upload PUT or an upsert grant.

result.description: Validated by the allowlisted job/stage result schema. prepare_document uses contracts/json-schema/document-preparation.schema.json; source_asset_id is null only for direct pasted text, while real files require their verified asset ID.

default_audience_preset_id.description: Audience an ordinary new series uses. Null until a Studio manager chooses it in Settings; never set by a migration.
Default review audience for ordinary new series (an active preset), or null to clear it.

CandidateSupport.description: Explicit supporting attachment, separate from extracted frames and reusable facts.

CandidateSupportArchive.description: Archive only the supporting-file association at its current version. No reason, asset deletion or other fields are accepted.

GuestBrowserAccess.description: Cookie-based browser adapter. Raw session credential exists only in a scoped HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie; guest_session_id is a public context selector, never a bearer.

original_text.description: Frozen original-language provenance; use the captured english_text for English display. Never read current library text for an old version.

english_text.description: English display transcript. Absence is explicit; never substitute original-language text.

VersionTranscriptCompanion.description: Plain original source text captured immutably with this version/video. Not slide wording, captions or factual review. No live-library fallback; legacy versions explicitly report not_captured.

PortraitCrop.description: Focus point (0..1 of width/height), used identically by preview, PDF and PowerPoint. No other keys (no crop rectangle).

WorkspaceCandidateAdded.description: The project membership. already_member is true when the person was already in the project (added by someone else, a retry or a concurrent request); nothing was changed then.

portrait_asset_id.description: Project presentation picture: a ready extracted frame or archive photo asset of this person. Library edits never change it.

media_selection_state.description: unset = legacy row, nothing chosen; pinned = chosen (by a person or the add default); intentionally_empty = deliberately no picture.

tape_count.description: Introduction recordings stored for this person.

processing.description: A new introduction for this person is still being processed.

LibraryCandidate.description: A Cast Library search row: the profile plus card fields, read in the same query.

CandidateUploadRow.description: One of the caller's candidate video uploads in a project, with its processing state.

MediaRepairSuggestion.description: A legacy project row with nothing chosen and the default it would receive (newest ready introduction, its frames, cover photo else first frame).

MediaRepairResult.description: Rows repaired, and rows left alone with the reason (changed since listed, already chosen, nothing available, not found).

slot_ids.description: Subset of the role's active slots shown for this scene; [] = every slot of the role.

deck_placement.description: auto = printed once at the first occurrence with a combined setting caption; repeat = also printed here; hidden = not printed here.

proposal_stale.description: True for a proposal made against an older version of the role (renamed or requirements changed since); confirming skips it. Review and link again or reject it.

SceneOccurrence.description: A canonical role (character) appearing in a scene. Every occurrence of one role shares its slots, Main/Option/Backup and shortlist.

Scene.description: A structured scene of the project. Scenes reference roles only through occurrences; casting stays on roles and slots.

scene_position.description: 1-based position in the active scene order.

scene_ids.description: Exactly the full active scene set in its new order.

slot_ids.description: Subset of the role's active slots shown for this scene; [] = every slot of the role.

deck_placement.description: auto = printed once at the first occurrence with a combined setting caption; repeat = also printed here; hidden = not printed here.

slot_ids.description: Subset of the role's active slots shown for this scene; [] = every slot of the role.

deck_placement.description: auto = printed once at the first occurrence with a combined setting caption; repeat = also printed here; hidden = not printed here.

SceneProposalConfirm.description: Omit both lists to confirm every active proposal in the workspace.

skipped_occurrence_ids.description: Stale proposals left for review (the role changed since the proposal).

skipped_scene_ids.description: Proposed scenes not rejected because they hold a confirmed link (unlink it or confirm the scene).

search.description: The same supplied-fact filters sent to search_candidates, so counts match its results.
